ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; approximately 95% dark pigment (black/dark grey) with <5% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels restricted to peripheral edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the macro-surface. Distinct high-contrast white focal clusters are localized at the distal tips and sporadically as minute points along the mid-to-trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 20-30 degrees and deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with high amplitude. Notable macro-indentations (peaks and valleys) occur along the entire trailing boundary, with a significant deep indentation on the right lobe approximately 30% of the distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering toward sharp, slightly posteriorly-hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller, isolated white circular spots are visible on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions (light grey) visible in the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe, suggesting previous physical trauma or extreme wear; dense white scarring/crusting at the distal tips.
